sections.title: Adding a New Command
sections.content: Adding commands is simple: create a module in `src/commands/` with an async function, register it in the switch statement of `bin/cli.mjs`, and update the descriptions in `src/commands/help.js`.

examples.code: Step 1: Create src/commands/makeMiddleware.js\nStep 2: Register in bin/cli.mjs\nStep 3: Add to src/commands/help.js
examples.explanation: Workflow for adding a new CLI command
